title: The Belvedere | Blue Mountain Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: The Belvedere - Luxury Vacation Rental Near the Beach with Huge Pool & Volleyball CourtFavorite Features:- Private Pool...
description_expanded: The Belvedere - Luxury Vacation Rental Near the Beach with Huge Pool & Volleyball Court Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Sand Volleyball - Firepit - Putting Green - Dining Pavilion - Outdoor Kitchen - Shuffleboard Table - Rooftop Sun Deck - Multiple Balconies - 4 Complementary Bikes - 3 Sets of Backpack Chairs - 6 Passenger Golf Cart  *NEW CONSTRUCTION* More about The Belvedere: The Belvedere is an extravagant house full of luxurious high-end finishes on 30A in Blue Mountain Beach. Sleeping 22 across 8 bedrooms, this is the perfect home to host your next group getaway! With a private pool, sand volleyball and game room, The Belvedere has all the indoor and outdoor amenities you’ll need to host a grand vacation and create memories of a lifetime! As you enter The Belvedere you step right into the fun! You’ll find a living area, seating five, with a flat-screen TV. Adjacent to the living room there is a chic wet bar with a full refrigerator, sink and wine cooler for creating cocktails to be enjoyed while playing a round on the Shuffleboard table. After that, step out back into a wonderland of outdoor activities! First you’ll find everything you’ll need to create a gourmet meal in the outdoor kitchen complete with a four-burner grill, sink, ice maker and mini-fridge. Feel free to lounge in the outdoor living areas with couches, bar seating and flat-screen TV while you wait on the grill. Nearby there is a pavilion with a dining table for ten to gather and enjoy your meal. Garden lights are strung above to create a magical experience during dinner. The centerpiece of this fabulous space is the large private pool and full size sand volleyball, a rare find! There is even a putting green for those who want to keep their putting game in tip top shape. There are three bedrooms on the first level - one queen bedroom with private bathroom, and one king bedroom with private bathroom and private access to the outdoor area. The third bedroom is a bunk room with two full/full bunk beds, each bed with its own TV. It shares a common bathroom for this floor which also includes a shower. The second floor houses four bedrooms as well as the laundry. The laundry area has two sets of washers and dryers to handle the needs of the house. Another bunk room with two full/full bunk beds, again each bed has its own TV are on this level. Across the hall is a common bathroom for them which includes a shower. Next is a king bedroom with a private full bathroom. The third is a double queen bedroom complete with a full private bathroom, pool view and access to a shared balcony. Lastly on this level is a king bedroom with a private full bathroom, stand alone tub, pool view and access to the shared balcony.  The main living area resides on the third floor. Here you will enjoy open concept living, dining and kitchen with access to large balconies. At this level, there is a feeling of being in the trees, paired with calming coastal colors that provide serenity as you relax and gather. The living room offers a cozy couch and chairs with enough seating for 5 and a flat screen TV. As you move around the room, you will next encounter the formal dining table seating ten and access to al fresco dining seating six. Off the dining room is a powder room and a gourmet kitchen fit for any chef with high end appliances and finishes. This includes an oversized refrigerator, eight burner Viking stove, double oven, wet-bar with icemaker and a separate beverage cooler. Lovely open shelving and marble countertops adorn the kitchen for a luxurious feel. The kitchen also provides the main access to a pool side balcony. From this balcony, guests can take a spiral staircase up to the fourth floor sun deck for an even higher vantage point of the neighborhood or for experiencing a gorgeous sunset. The final sleeping arrangement is a king bedroom just off the kitchen, complete with a private bathroom that includes a walk-in shower. This bedroom has a view of the pool and private access to the balcony leading to the spiral stairs.  Just a short distance from the beach and centrally located amongst restaurants, The Belvedere provides all the luxury amenities needed for hosting the gathering of a lifetime without even leaving the house. Be sure to book your perfect vacation at The Belvedere! *Pool can be heated for an additional fee Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Patio Access & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: 2 Full over Full Bunk Beds. Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 4: 2 Full over Full Bunk Beds & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: 2 Queen Beds with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 7: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 8: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
